reason: The guarded next-step B prefetch and loop scheduling changes keep the active n=512 path and its FP32 update order, with limited source changes. Prior active-path schedule measurements were noisy and did not pass promotion, so these remain hypotheses. Fusing transpose with packing targets the fallback path, but the fixed n=512 timing does not measure it and the proposal needs a precise layout design. The padded A layout and packed-B proposals add scratch or timed conversion work without evidence of cache benefit; the two B layouts describe the same packing scheme, so they should not be treated as independent gains. Transpose fusion repeats A reads across column panels, making its full-call benefit least supported.
